parsed_profile.title: F-CLASS BALANCE WEIGHT GROOVE ENTRY SLOT RECOMMENDATIONS
parsed_profile.purpose: To advise users of the recommendation to inspect compressor aft shaft (CAS) and distance piece (DP) balance weight groove entry slots corner and perform blending operations.
parsed_profile.compliance_category_text: Safety - Failure to comply with this TIL could result in personal injury. Compliance is mandated within a specific operating time.
scope_of_work: FPI to inspect BWG entry slot pre-blending condition
Set up BWG Entry Slot tool and perform blending operation
FPI to inspect BWG entry slot post-blending condition
Flapper peen the modified geometry post machining and post machining successful FPI
service_recommendation_line_items: Perform fluorescent penetrant inspection (FPI) for all BWG entry slots on the CAS and DP during the next planned HGP or MI outage at or before the rotor reaches 378,000 equivalent cold rotor turning time (ECRT) hours
For FPI clear cases - evaluate all balance entry slot corner conditions with replication process
If any balance weight entry slot corner condition presents with a <0.060" fillet size - perform entry slot blending, FPI, and peening operations
If any portion of a specific balance weight groove corner meets the <0.060" fillet criteria, perform modification machining on the entire BWG entry slot corner
Fillet >0.060" and uniformly this size over full length of the BWG entry slot corner - leave in as-found condition
For cases with observable FPI indication/indications - contact GE engineering through an ER case for technical disposition
In service center, MPI inspection may be substituted for FPI inspection based on service center capability
parsed_profile.completion_criteria_text: This TIL may be considered complete after completion of the FPI/MPI inspection and the CAS and DP geometry is modified.
parsed_profile.maintenance_trigger_text: At first exposure of component (Timing Code 4); next planned HGP or MI outage at or before rotor reaches 378,000 equivalent cold rotor turning time hours.
recommended_interval_or_trigger: At first exposure of component (Timing Code 4)
Next planned HGP or MI outage at or before rotor reaches 378,000 equivalent cold rotor turning time (ECRT) hours
parsed_profile.usage_counter_requirements_text: Equivalent Cold Rotor Turning Time (ECRT) must be calculated using turning gear hours, fired starts, forced cool downs, forced cool hours, cool starts (warm 2 and cold starts per GER-3620), and offline water washes. ECRT = TTG - ((SFS-SFC)*X) + TFC*0.25*(20% Full Speed / 6) + (Swc*Y) + (Sww*3*(20% Full Speed / 6)). Inspection required at or before 378,000 ECRT hours.
parsed_profile.hardware_or_part_configuration_text: Compressor aft shaft (CAS) and distance piece (DP) balance weight groove entry slots. Applicable to components with BWG entry slots containing corner fillet size <0.060".
parsed_profile.exclusions_or_non_applicable_conditions_: Fillet >0.060" and uniformly this size over full length of the BWG entry slot corner - leave in as-found condition (no modification required).
parsed_profile.prerequisite_outage_or_inspection_contex: Requires rotor exposure during HGP or MI outage. Component must be accessible for FPI/MPI and potential machining operations.

parts_referenced.context: Compressor Aft Shaft (CAS) - balance weight groove entry slots requiring FPI inspection and potential blending
Distance Piece (DP) - balance weight groove entry slots requiring FPI inspection and potential blending
BWG Entry Slot Portable Machining Tool - special tooling required for blending operation
Flapper peening kit - required for peening modified geometry post machining

reference_documents.context: Referenced for definition of warm 2 and cold starts (figure 22, latest revision) used in ECRT calculation

configuration_variables: BWG entry slot corner fillet size (<0.060" vs >0.060")
parsed_profile.configuration_summary: ECRT calculation parameters vary by frame size (X factor: 6FA=18, 7FA=24, 9FA=24; full speed: 6FA=5250rpm, 7FA=3600rpm, 9FA=3000rpm; forced cool Z factor: 6FA=24, 7FA=8, 9FA=12) and by cycle type (SC Y=72, CC Y=86). Blending action depends on measured fillet size at BWG entry slot corners.
severity_signals: Separation of either shaft into two separate pieces
components to exit the gas turbine
failure_consequences: Crack-like indications may form over the lifetime of the component at BWG entry slot corners
If crack-like indications propagate to large enough size, continued rapid crack growth may occur associated with gravity sag related bending (high cycle fatigue)
Fracture propagation may lead the CAS and/or DP to separate into two separate pieces
Separation may create possibility for components to exit the gas turbine
Possibility for INJURY TO PERSONNEL/INDIVIDUALS and substantial damage to adjacent equipment
parsed_profile.risk_summary: Variation in BWG entry slot corner condition combined with operational stresses (gravity sag, startup/shutdown) can initiate crack-like indications that may propagate via high cycle fatigue, potentially leading to CAS or DP shaft separation, component ejection from the gas turbine, personnel injury, and substantial equipment damage.

tables_found_summary.reason: Required for calculating equivalent cold rotor turning time to determine inspection timing threshold of 378,000 hours

source_snippets.snippet: To advise users of the recommendation to inspect compressor aft shaft (CAS) and distance piece (DP) balance weight groove entry slots corner and perform blending operations.

If not mitigated, the fracture propagation may lead the CAS and/or DP to separate into two separate pieces. Separation of either shaft into two pieces may create the possibility for components to exit the gas turbine leading to the possibility for INJURY TO PERSONNEL/INDIVIDUALS and substantial damage to adjacent equipment.

It is recommended to perform fluorescent penetrant inspection (FPI) for all BWG entry slots on the CAS and DP during the next planned outage for the unit Hot Gas Path (HGP) or Major Inspection (MI) at or before the rotor reaches a total of 378,000 equivalent cold rotor turning time.
This TIL may be considered complete after completion of the FPI/MPI inspection and the CAS and DP geometry is modified.

If any balance weight entry slot corner condition presents with a <0.060" fillet size - perform entry slot blending, FPI, and peening operations to mitigate the risk of crack initiation and propagation.
Simple Cycle Unit (SC) Y = 72; Combined Cycle Unit (CC) Y = 86
